name: Trusted public-menu composition and route wiring with explicit publication selection
identifierOrigin: OWNER-DIRECTED POST-FOOD-004B FORMALIZATION; newly established identifier/title.

contract.authority: FOOD-004A owns exact menu assembly; FOOD-004B owns methods/status/headers/serialization. C only acquires trusted configuration, composes existing repositories and adapts transport data to Response. No auth/private service/workspace/operation gate.
contract.configuration: Trusted cloudflare:workers env only, following existing endpoint convention. RIVER_FOOD_PUBLIC_MENU_PUBLICATION_ID must pass canonical ID validator; RIVER_FOOD_PUBLIC_MENU_PUBLICATION_VERSION must be a canonical positive decimal string matching [1-9][0-9]* and canonical safe version validator. No trimming/coercion/default/latest/current/fallback. Values are copied/frozen per composition and never logged. No production values are committed.
contract.dependencies: Reuse acquirePrivateFoodMenuDatabaseFromEnvironment structural acquisition with existing RIVER_FOOD_DB binding. One acquired database constructs D1FoodDraftRepository, createFoodMenuReadDependencies, D1FoodMenuRepository, FOOD-004A and FOOD-004B. No SQL/schema/storage format changes. Constructors perform no I/O; route uses exact reads only. Repository mutation methods stay internal and no repository is returned.
contract.failure: Absent/malformed configuration or expected acquisition/construction failure produces FOOD-004B transport with unavailable selector, yielding fixed 503. No diagnostics or config/binding values escape. Unsupported methods are delegated to FOOD-004B before acquiring environment/database; HEAD preserves status/headers without body. No request body/query/header/cookie/route parameter access.
contract.route: Thin Astro ALL endpoint, prerender=false, passes request.method and lazy trusted environment acquisition to request handler. Handler creates per-request graph and native Response with exact transport status/headers/body. No enrichment, global caches, logging, HTML/UI or price/orderability.
contract.deployment: Route source is not deployed production. Deployment and production publication selection remain separately authorized. No Cloudflare/D1/KV mutations or deployment commands.
contract.deploymentDiscovery: AUTO_DEPLOY_ON_PUSH=NO_EVIDENCE: only repository GitHub workflow validates main; package build is local Astro/Pagefind, deploy/publish/release are explicit Wrangler paths; Git hooks are samples and no core.hooksPath set. Repository evidence cannot attest external provider settings; no external service contacted.

validation: Bounded strict TypeScript including Astro route
exclusions: No configuration values, Wrangler/type regeneration, migrations, writes, new persistence, UI, cart/quote/order/payment, production data, credentials/PII, staging/commit/push/deployment.
